body.purpose: All reading text; controls at 13.5px weight 600.

on-air.purpose: Italic condensed captions on broadcast graphics: method tags, activity verbs, ticker label (16px uppercase), score bug label, toast titles, stamps, assistant speaker names.

shadows.purpose: Panels, tables, board cells at rest.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The single exponential ease-out for every transition and entrance.

motion.name: spring
motion.purpose: Only the switch thumb (350ms) and the notification count badge pop-in (400ms).

motion.name: wipe-in
motion.value: 420ms var(--ease); clip-path diagonal polygon from the left plus 10px slide
motion.purpose: Scoreboard cells, board panels, home cost figures; staggered 60-80ms.

motion.name: curtain
motion.value: 420ms var(--ease); azzurro slab clipped away diagonally
motion.purpose: Page transition behind page-enter (content rises 14px over 500ms).

motion.name: lower-third
motion.value: 500-550ms var(--ease); clip-path inset reveal from the left
motion.purpose: Toasts, activity rows, assistant replies, draft estimate, login ribbon.

motion.name: ticker-in
motion.value: 500ms var(--ease); 60px slide from the right with clip reveal
motion.purpose: Request chips entering the DIRETTA ticker; duration underline grows 600ms after 200ms.

motion.name: count-up
motion.purpose: Scoreboard numerals counting from their previous value; a change flashes a skewed team-colour slab over 1s.

motion.name: grow-x
motion.purpose: Team stripes, progress fills, cost bars.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Global rule; curtain and scoreboard sheen hidden; counters jump straight to value.

narrative.overview:
The console narrates the developer's cloud the way Italian television narrates a national-team or Serie A match. Night-blue broadcast chrome frames the whole screen: a rail and topbar in deep night blue, a score bug in the topbar naming the active directory (EMULATORE or AZURE) with a live clock, and a DIRETTA ticker along the bottom where every API request runs past as a chip. Inside that frame the working surface is light and friendly. An ice-blue ground carries white panels with soft corners. The controls inside them are ordinary, legible form controls that never perform.

On-air graphics are reserved for the moments that tell the story. The home screen opens on a full-width scoreboard: giant italic condensed numerals that count up, each cell topped by a team-colour stripe. Changes arrive as lower thirds (toasts, the activity stack, assistant replies) that wipe in from the left with their colour band leading. Requests arrive in the ticker with an ochre underline whose length is the request's duration. Diagonal cuts, clip-path wipes and italic condensed Saira mark something as broadcast graphics; everything else stays upright and calm.

The world rejects the grey Fluent clone of the Azure portal and the dark neon console. Density is high and full-width, because the users read IDs, JSON and paths beside a terminal.
keyCharacteristics: Night-blue broadcast chrome (rail, topbar, ticker, scoreboard, lower thirds) around a light ice-blue working floor with white rounded panels.
One action colour, Azzurri blue. Cards (rosso, giallo, verde) are reserved for state, and gold marks writes and highlights.
Every resource category has a team colour, used on its icon tile and as the scoreboard stripe.
Saira variable on two registers: heavy italic condensed for the on-air register and normal width for the interface. Martian Mono handles IDs, paths, payloads and timings.
Motion is a broadcast wipe on one exponential ease. Numbers count up, panels wipe in diagonally, and pages change behind an azzurro curtain.

rules.name: The One Action Colour Rule
rules.body: Azzurri blue is the only colour that means "do this". Cards never decorate, and gold never means "click".

rules.name: The Cards Are For State Rule
rules.body: Rosso, giallo and verde appear only when something failed or is destructive, is waiting, or succeeded. A panel is never tinted rosso for emphasis.

rules.name: The Ink On Light Kits Rule
rules.body: Oro, giallo, arancio and team-monitor fills always carry ink text, never white.

rules.name: The Two Registers Rule
rules.body: Italic condensed heavy Saira means "on air", so it appears only on broadcast graphics and big numbers. Buttons, form labels, table cells and body copy stay upright at normal width.

rules.name: The Mono Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Martian Mono is reserved for things the machine said: IDs, paths, HTTP payloads, durations. Prose never uses it.

rules.name: The Flat Floor Rule
rules.body: Panels are flat at rest. Lift belongs to things that float or that you can press.

rules.name: The Cut Means On Air Rule
rules.body: Diagonal cuts and skews belong only to broadcast graphics: the scoreboard, score bug, lower thirds (toasts, activity verbs) and the ticker (its label and its method tags). Buttons, inputs, panels, tabs and badges are never cut. The same method tag inside the request drawer list is a rounded 5px pill, not a cut.

dos: Do use azzurro for every primary action and selected state, and nothing else for that job.
Do put broadcast moments (counts, live events, requests, confirmations) on night blue with italic condensed Saira and a leading colour band.
Do give each resource category its team colour on its icon tile and scoreboard stripe, with ink text on oro, giallo, arancio and team-monitor.
Do set IDs, paths, payloads and durations in Martian Mono at 87.5% width with tabular numerals.
Do animate on the single exponential ease (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`). Wipes run 420ms, lower thirds 500 to 550ms, and counters 900ms.
Do keep `--spring` for the switch thumb and the notification count badge only.
Do let every motion collapse to instant under reduced motion, including counters, the curtain and the scoreboard sheen.
Do keep the preserved logo mark (open "A" on #0b3fbf with an #e8a917 crossbar) and the lowercase "azzurro" logotype (800, 75% width) exactly as shipped.
donts: Don't cut, skew or italicise buttons, inputs, panels, tabs or badges. Diagonals mean "on air".
Don't use rosso, giallo or verde as decoration or emphasis. They are referee cards for state.
Don't put white text on oro, giallo, arancio or team-monitor.
Don't fall back to the grey Fluent look of the Azure portal or to a dark neon console.
Don't centre content in a narrow container. The board uses the full width.
Don't add a second easing curve or bouncy motion outside the two `--spring` uses.
Don't recolour the logo mark to the world's azzurro or oro, and don't use the logo's hexes as UI tokens.
